cond_0001.intro:
[Company name masked] Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation and day-to-day financial operations as [Company name masked] scales its mission impact with new and existing products, technology and business models to better serve users and advance an agenda for a healthier internet.
We are seeking a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role will report to our Strategic Finance Lead and partner directly with leaders in our sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success organizations. The role will focus on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue and play a critical part in driving informed decision-making by providing accurate and actionable insights related to ARR performance. This role will partner across GTM executive leadership and will help influence strategic decisions and growth opportunities for each of the GTM functions. This is a fantastic opportunity for a candidate who wants to be part of a dynamic FP&A organization that is scaling for the future.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and a deep understanding of the drivers of subscription-based business models. They will have experience with Revenue modeling for several products and pricing structures, and they will have a strong track record of providing structure, consolidation, and analysis of ARR & Revenue data.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Conduct a thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, drive ownership, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and partner with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Continuously refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR & Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Partner closely with Revenue and Marketing teams to set strategy around pricing and promotional initiatives.
Be an effective and memorable presenter. Use storytelling with content and delivery to persuade and inspire teams to take action and prioritize resources.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong understanding of subscription-based business models and key metrics such as MRR, Churn, CAC, and LTV
Advanced proficiency in Excel modeling skills (including VBA, Pivot Tables, array functions, Power Pivots, etc) – to develop complex and scalable models with sensible assumptions from large data sets
Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides
Familiarity with combining and manipulating data tables and sets – joins, unions, etc.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence through creating fellowship
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field with 6+ years of work experience
Preferred Requirements
4-6 Years of FP&A or Finance experience (SaaS and/or high-growth companies)
Knowledge of SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization

We are seeking a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role will report to our Strategic Finance Lead and partner directly with leaders in our sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success organizations. The role will focus on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue and play a critical part in driving informed decision-making by providing accurate and actionable insights related to ARR performance. This role will partner across GTM executive leadership and will help influence strategic decisions and growth opportunities for each of the GTM functions. This is a fantastic opportunity for a candidate who wants to be part of a dynamic FP&A organization that is scaling for the future.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and a deep understanding of the drivers of subscription-based business models. They will have experience with Revenue modeling for several products and pricing structures, and they will have a strong track record of providing structure, consolidation, and analysis of ARR & Revenue data.
cond_0182.responsibilities:
Conduct a thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, drive ownership, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and partner with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Continuously refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR & Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Partner closely with Revenue and Marketing teams to set strategy around pricing and promotional initiatives.
Be an effective and memorable presenter. Use storytelling with content and delivery to persuade and inspire teams to take action and prioritize resources.
cond_0182.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 6 years of demonstrated expertise in FP&A or Finance.
Deep knowledge of subscription-based business models and key metrics such as MRR, Churn, CAC, and LTV.
Advanced expertise in Excel modeling (including VBA, Pivot Tables, array functions, Power Pivots, etc.) to develop complex and scalable models with sensible assumptions from large data sets.
Strong command of Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides.
Proven track record of combining and manipulating data tables and sets — joins, unions, etc.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to influence through creating fellowship.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience in SaaS and/or high-growth companies.
Proficiency in SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization.
cond_0182.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0182.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0202.intro:
[Company name masked] Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation and day-to-day financial operations as [Company name masked] scales its mission impact with new and existing products, technology and business models to better serve users and advance an agenda for a healthier internet.
We are seeking a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role will report to our Strategic Finance Lead and partner directly with leaders in our sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success organizations. The role will focus on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue and play a critical part in driving informed decision-making by providing accurate and actionable insights related to ARR performance. This role will partner across GTM executive leadership and will help influence strategic decisions and growth opportunities for each of the GTM functions. This is a fantastic opportunity for a candidate who wants to be part of a dynamic FP&A organization that is scaling for the future.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and a deep understanding of the drivers of subscription-based business models. They will have experience with Revenue modeling for several products and pricing structures, and they will have a strong track record of providing structure, consolidation, and analysis of ARR & Revenue data. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of subscription metrics and how they connect to broader business performance.
cond_0202.responsibilities:
Conduct a thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, drive ownership, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and partner with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Continuously refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR & Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Partner closely with Revenue and Marketing teams to set strategy around pricing and promotional initiatives.
Be an effective and memorable presenter. Use storytelling with content and delivery to persuade and inspire teams to take action and prioritize resources.

Advanced proficiency in Excel modeling skills (including VBA, Pivot Tables, array functions, Power Pivots, etc) to develop complex and scalable models with sensible assumptions from large data sets
Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides
Familiarity with combining and manipulating data tables and sets – joins, unions, etc.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence through creating fellowship

Experience at SaaS and/or high-growth companies
Knowledge of SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization
You will likely be super happy and productive in this role if you are action-oriented and get things done, know how to crunch data in Excel and create compelling presentations, have a strong builder mentality and can bring order to chaos, and are able to effectively challenge the status quo and plan insightful roadmaps.

[Company name masked] Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation and day-to-day financial operations as [Company name masked] scales its mission impact with new and existing products, technology and business models to better serve users and advance an agenda for a healthier internet.
We are seeking a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role will report to our Strategic Finance Lead and partner directly with leaders in our sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success organizations. The role will focus on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue and play a critical part in driving informed decision-making by providing accurate and actionable insights related to ARR performance. This role will partner across GTM executive leadership and will help influence strategic decisions and growth opportunities for each of the GTM functions. This is a fantastic opportunity for a candidate who wants to be part of a dynamic FP&A organization that is scaling for the future.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and a deep understanding of the drivers of subscription-based business models. They will have experience with Revenue modeling for several products and pricing structures, and they will have a strong track record of providing structure, consolidation, and analysis of ARR & Revenue data.
cond_0291.responsibilities:
Conduct a thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, drive ownership, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and partner with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Continuously refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR & Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Partner closely with Revenue and Marketing teams to set strategy around pricing and promotional initiatives.
Be an effective and memorable presenter. Use storytelling with content and delivery to persuade and inspire teams to take action and prioritize resources.
cond_0291.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 4–6 years of FP&A or Finance experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Working knowledge of subscription-based business models and key metrics such as MRR, Churn, CAC, and LTV
Comfort with Excel modeling (including VBA, Pivot Tables, array functions, Power Pivots, etc.) to build scalable models from large data sets
Familiarity with combining and manipulating data tables and sets — joins, unions, etc.
Ability to communicate effectively in both written and verbal form
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 6 years of work experience
Preferred Requirements
Background in SaaS and/or high-growth companies
Experience with Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides
Exposure to SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization
Openness to working collaboratively and building relationships across teams
cond_0291.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0505.intro:
[Company name masked] Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation and day-to-day financial operations as [Company name masked] scales its mission impact with new and existing products, technology and business models to better serve users and advance an agenda for a healthier internet.
We are seeking a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role will report to our Strategic Finance Lead and partner directly with leaders in our sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success organizations. The role will focus on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue and play a critical part in driving informed decision-making by providing accurate and actionable insights related to ARR performance. This role will partner across GTM executive leadership and will help influence strategic decisions and growth opportunities for each of the GTM functions. This is a fantastic opportunity for a candidate who wants to be part of a dynamic FP&A organization that is scaling for the future.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and a deep understanding of the drivers of subscription-based business models. They will have experience with Revenue modeling for several products and pricing structures, and they will have a strong track record of providing structure, consolidation, and analysis of ARR & Revenue data.
cond_0505.responsibilities:
Conduct a thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, drive ownership, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and partner with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Continuously refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR & Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Partner closely with Revenue and Marketing teams to set strategy around pricing and promotional initiatives.
Be an effective and memorable presenter. Use storytelling with content and delivery to persuade and inspire teams to take action and prioritize resources.
cond_0505.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong understanding of subscription-based business models and key metrics such as MRR, Churn, CAC, and LTV
Advanced proficiency in Excel modeling skills (including VBA, Pivot Tables, array functions, Power Pivots, etc) – to develop complex and scalable models with sensible assumptions from large data sets
Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides
Familiarity with combining and manipulating data tables and sets – joins, unions, etc.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence through creating fellowship
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field with 6+ years of work experience
Preferred Requirements
4-6 Years of FP&A or Finance experience (SaaS and/or high-growth companies)
Knowledge of SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization

We are seeking a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role will report to our Strategic Finance Lead and partner directly with leaders in our sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success organizations. The role will focus on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue and play a critical part in driving informed decision-making by providing accurate and actionable insights related to ARR performance. This role will partner across GTM executive leadership and will help influence strategic decisions and growth opportunities for each of the GTM functions. This is a fantastic opportunity for a candidate who wants to be part of a dynamic FP&A organization that is scaling for the future.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and a deep understanding of the drivers of subscription-based business models. They will have experience with Revenue modeling for several products and pricing structures, and they will have a strong track record of providing structure, consolidation, and analysis of ARR & Revenue data. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of subscription metrics and how they connect to broader business performance.
cond_0544.responsibilities:
Conduct a thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, drive ownership, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and partner with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Continuously refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR & Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Partner closely with Revenue and Marketing teams to set strategy around pricing and promotional initiatives.
Be an effective and memorable presenter. Use storytelling with content and delivery to persuade and inspire teams to take action and prioritize resources.
cond_0544.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field with 6+ years of work experience
4-6 Years of FP&A or Finance experience
Strong understanding of subscription-based business models and key metrics such as MRR, Churn, CAC, and LTV
Advanced proficiency in Excel modeling skills (including VBA, Pivot Tables, array functions, Power Pivots, etc) to develop complex and scalable models with sensible assumptions from large data sets
Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides
Familiarity with combining and manipulating data tables and sets – joins, unions, etc.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence through creating fellowship
Preferred Requirements
Experience at SaaS and/or high-growth companies
Knowledge of SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization
You will likely be super happy and productive in this role if you are action-oriented and get things done, know how to crunch data in Excel and create compelling presentations, have a strong builder mentality and can bring order to chaos, and are able to effectively challenge the status quo and plan insightful roadmaps.

cond_0592.intro:
[Company name masked] Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation and day-to-day financial operations as [Company name masked] scales its mission impact with new and existing products, technology, and business models.
We are looking for a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance Team focused on Revenue and ARR. This role reports to our Strategic Finance Lead and coordinates with leaders in sales, product marketing, revenue, and customer success. The role focuses on analyzing and forecasting ARR and Revenue, providing accurate and actionable insights to support informed decision-making around ARR performance. The analyst will interface with GTM executive leadership to support strategic decisions and growth opportunities across GTM functions.
The ideal candidate will have a solid background in financial analysis and strategic planning, with a clear understanding of subscription-based business model drivers. They will have experience with Revenue modeling across multiple products and pricing structures, and a track record of structuring, consolidating, and analyzing ARR and Revenue data.
cond_0592.responsibilities:
Conduct thorough analysis of Annual Recurring Revenue, including trend analysis, variance explanations, and performance metrics to monitor overall business performance.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to produce accurate ARR forecasts that align with overall company guardrails.
Build standardized ARR reporting for the executive leadership team to provide visibility, support ownership, and identify risks and opportunities.
Own top-line Revenue models for multiple products and coordinate with Revenue Accounting to expand recognized revenue reporting.
Refine and improve FP&A processes related to ARR and Revenue analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Support the development of deal metrics to report trends in pricing, product, customer lifecycle, and commission targets.
Coordinate with Revenue and Marketing teams on pricing and promotional initiatives.
Communicate findings clearly through written documentation and structured presentations that give leadership the information needed to act.

Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Slides; knowledge of SQL and experience with Google Looker/BigQuery for data analysis and visualization are highly desirable
Familiarity with combining and manipulating data tables and sets — joins, unions, etc.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Ability to work through others and build alignment around data-driven conclusions
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, with 6+ years of work experience
Action-oriented with the ability to set challenging goals and develop plans to deliver on them
Comfortable working with numbers and translating them into structured, clear outputs
Strong builder mentality; able to bring order to ambiguous situations
